title: SEO Manager
description:
SEO Manager

**Company:** Foodsure  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Department:** Digital Marketing  
**Experience:** 8–11 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** On-Site

About the Role

Foodsure is looking for a highly experienced and strategic **SEO Manager** with **8–11 years of hands-on experience** to lead the organization’s organic growth strategy.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, Content SEO, Keyword Strategy, Website Optimization, SEO Analytics, and Team Management**. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing high-impact SEO strategies, improving organic visibility, driving qualified traffic, and contributing to business growth through organic search.

Key ResponsibilitiesSEO Strategy & Leadership

* Develop and lead the overall SEO strategy aligned with business and revenue objectives.
* Create long-term SEO roadmaps and quarterly/monthly action plans.
* Identify opportunities to increase organic traffic, visibility, leads, and conversions.
* Stay updated with Google algorithm updates, search trends, AI search developments, and industry changes.
* Conduct regular SEO audits and develop corrective and growth strategies.
* Define SEO KPIs and establish performance benchmarks.

Technical SEO

* Lead comprehensive technical SEO audits and identify critical website issues.
* Manage crawlability, indexability, site architecture, URL structures, canonicalization, redirects, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and structured data.
* Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, and website performance.
* Identify duplicate content, broken links, indexing issues, rendering problems, and other technical challenges.
* Work closely with developers to implement technical SEO recommendations.
* Review website migrations, redesigns, new landing pages, and major technical changes from an SEO perspective.

On-Page & Content SEO

* Develop advanced keyword research and search-intent strategies.
* Lead optimization of landing pages, category pages, product/service pages, blogs, and other website content.
* Develop content clusters, pillar pages, topic strategies, and content-gap plans.
* Work closely with content teams to create SEO briefs and optimization guidelines.
* Improve titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, schema, images, and overall content structure.
* Identify underperforming pages and develop optimization strategies to improve their organic performance.

Off-Page SEO & Authority Building

* Develop and manage sustainable link-building and digital PR strategies.
* Identify high-quality and relevant backlink opportunities.
* Monitor backlink quality, referring domains, and competitor link profiles.
* Develop strategies to improve website authority and industry visibility.
* Conduct competitor backlink and authority analysis.

Analytics & Performance Management

* Monitor organic traffic, rankings, impressions, CTR, conversions, leads, and revenue contribution.
* Analyze performance through **Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog**, and other relevant SEO platforms.
* Prepare detailed weekly, monthly, and quarterly SEO performance reports.
* Identify performance trends and provide data-driven recommendations to management.
* Establish attribution and measurement frameworks for organic acquisition wherever practical.

Competitor & Market Analysis

* Conduct detailed competitor SEO analysis.
* Track competitor keyword rankings, content strategies, backlinks, SERP features, and organic visibility.
* Identify market gaps and opportunities for Foodsure.
* Develop strategies to outperform competitors in relevant search categories.

Team Management

* Lead, mentor, and manage SEO Executives, SEO Specialists, SEO Interns, and related team members.
* Allocate responsibilities, set targets, and monitor team performance.
* Conduct regular reviews and provide strategic guidance.
* Build SEO processes, SOPs, reporting systems, and quality standards.
* Coordinate with Content, Development, Marketing, Design, and Business teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Web Development teams for technical SEO implementation.
* Collaborate with Content and Marketing teams for content and campaign strategies.
* Coordinate with senior management to communicate SEO performance and business impact.
* Ensure SEO is integrated into new website launches, campaigns, products, and digital initiatives.

Required Skills

* 8–11 years of strong professional experience in SEO.
* Proven experience managing large-scale SEO strategies and projects.
* Strong knowledge of Technical, On-Page, Off-Page, Local, and Content SEO.
* Advanced keyword research and competitor analysis skills.
* Strong understanding of Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
* Hands-on experience with Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of website architecture and technical SEO.
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and CMS platforms is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proven team-management and leadership experience.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Organic traffic growth
* Organic leads and conversions
* Keyword ranking growth
* Search visibility
* Organic CTR
* Revenue/business contribution from organic search
* Technical SEO health
* Quality and growth of referring domains
* Content performance
* Organic landing-page performance
* SEO project delivery and team performance

Educational Qualification

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

Relevant SEO certifications and experience in managing enterprise or high-traffic websites will be an advantage.

Why Join Foodsure?

* Opportunity to lead the SEO function of a growing organization.
* Direct ownership of organic growth strategy and performance.
* Opportunity to build and manage an SEO team.
* Cross-functional exposure across Marketing, Content, Technology, and Business.
* Growth-oriented and performance-driven work environment.

Application

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with details of their SEO experience, major projects handled, and relevant performance achievements.

**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience:** 8–11 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
